messages.subject: Plotting founder SNP marker association
parts:
Hello,
I have poured through the user guide, list of functions, and this discussion group but cannot seem to find a way to add the 8 DO/CC founder SNP marker associations when using plot_snpassoc().

I have seen versions of this figure in many papers and am struggling to get the top panel shown in Figure 3 in "Quantitative Trait Mapping in Diversity Outbred Mice Identifies Two Genomic Regions Associated With Heart Size"
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29279960/ 

Is there a  way to add it to the snp assoc plot or is it made separately and manually added together? If anyone knows the function for this in Rqtl2 or how to make the top founder panel I would really appreciate if you would share the knowledge with me.

Thanks in advance,
Jessica Mayeux

messages.author: 94aec44b51a53789
messages.subject: Re: Plotting founder SNP marker association
parts:
Karl,
Thank you. You were right and that explains why I was having trouble finding it in Rqtl2. I was able to make the plot in DOQTL and will just post here how to do that in case anyone else wants to make the plot:

#Use DOQTL to get SDP for association mapping.
#First convert genotype probabilities from Rqtl2 to DOQTL 
library(DOQTL)
library(qtl2convert)
probs = probs_qtl2_to_doqtl(apr)

#Make new kinship matrix
#Download snps from jax website: ftp://ftp.jax.org/MUGA/GM_snps.Rdata
K = kinship.probs(probs = probs, snps = GM_snps, bychr = FALSE)

#Run association map
#Dowload snp.file from jax website: ftp://ftp.jax.org/SNPtools/variants/mgp.v5.merged.snps_all.dbSNP142.vcf.gz and ftp://ftp.jax.org/SNPtools/variants/mgp.v5.merged.snps_all.dbSNP142.vcf.gz.tbi
results = assoc.map(pheno = pheno, pheno.col = 56, probs = probs, K = K, snps = GM_snps, snp.file = "~/DO/mgp.v5.merged.snps_all.dbSNP142.vcf.gz", chr = 17, start = 34.75, end = 37.75)
# This Warning Message is okay: Warning message:In .vcf_map_samples(samples(hdr), samples):samples not in file: ‘C57BL_6J’

#Plot Assocition map with SDP
assoc.plot(results = results, thr = 5, show.sdps = TRUE)

#To add genes dowload the following files from jax: ftp://ftp.jax.org/SNPtools/genes/MGI.sorted.txt.gz.tbi and ftp://ftp.jax.org/SNPtools/genes/MGI.sorted.txt.gz
assoc.plot(results = results, mgi.file = "~/DO/MGI.sorted.txt.gz", thr = 5, show.sdps = TRUE)

Jessica Mayeux
